title: Baku White City
description: A study in urban scale and everyday life. Classical façades, landscaped courtyards and street-level perspectives bring this residential setting into focus.

title: Marina Village, Sea Breeze
description: Arcaded façades, a distinctive clock tower and sunlit public spaces. A series of architectural views exploring the character of Marina Village.

title: 491 Central Avenue
description: Gabled rooflines and quiet streets. Exterior views that explore the relationship between residential architecture, landscape and natural light.

title: 491 Central — Inside
description: From the dining room to spaces for unwinding, this interior series studies materials, furniture and the subtle atmosphere of a lived-in home.

title: Portobello
description: An outdoor extension of the restaurant experience. Pergola structures frame the streetscape and create sheltered spaces for gathering.

title: Beverly Hills Hotel
description: Layered timber, filtered daylight and greenery give shape to an open-air dining space. The series follows the terrace through contrasting lighting conditions.

title: Baku — Façade Study
description: A façade study from the Baku Abadliq collection, exploring proportion, surface detail and the transition from building to street.

title: Silver Diner
description: Street-level commercial architecture seen through daylight and evening perspectives. Glass, signage and reflected light establish an urban presence.

title: Poolside Pavilion
description: A light, open pavilion beside the water. Clean structural lines and adjustable shading connect indoor comfort with outdoor living.

title: Residential Perspectives
description: A residential building explored from the street and above. Close views of the entrance complement wider studies of the building and its setting.

title: Above the City
description: Pergola and architectural lighting studies from the Nights collection, with a focus on the atmosphere of the city after sunset.
